title: 한국농공학회논문집 2023년 제65권 4호
headline: 농촌진흥청 연구진이 4편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘farming season’, ‘Agricultural residue’, ‘incineration’, ‘open burning’, ‘pelletization’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 현장 모니터링, 회귀분석, CN 방법, 단위도.

papers.title: 경사밭 고랑 식생 및 PAM (Polyacrylamide) 멀칭에 따른 영농기 비점오염 저감효과 분석
papers.title_en: Reduction Efficiency Analysis of Furrow Vegetation and PAM (Polyacrylamide) Mulching for Non-Point Source Pollution Load from Sloped Upland During Farming Season

summary.result: The analysis found that VM had a linear regression correlation (R 2 =0.28~0.86, P-value=0.01~0.1) with elapsed time of application, while PM had a quadratic regression correlation (R 2 =0.35~0.80, P-value=0.1).
summary.background: As a result of climate change, non-point source pollution (NPS) from farmland with the steep slope during the rainy season is expected to have a significant impact on the water system.
summary.method: Runoff was collected from each rainfall event using a 1/40 sampler and the NPS load was calculated by measuring the concentrations of SS, T-N, T-P, and TOC.

papers.title: 폐기물처리 비용을 고려한 국내 영농부산물 자원화 방안의 경제성과 환경성 분석
papers.title_en: Analysis of Environmental Implications and Economic Feasibility for Vitalizing Agricultural Residues as Resources Considering Waste Management Cost

summary.result: It is expected that the environmental, economic, and social findings of this study can be used to inform policies for bioenergy as the need for agricultural residue increases.
summary.background: In Korea, open burning of agricultural residues is prevalent due to inadequate collection systems, which have caused environmental impacts such as GHGs and particulates.
summary.method: Regarding the economic aspect, pelletizing facilities in all regions in Korea create economic benefits.

papers.title: 농지배수 수문설계 기준과 임계지속기간을 고려한 농업 소유역 침수분석
papers.title_en: Inundation Analysis of Agricultural Basin Considering Agricultural Drainage Hydrological Plan and Critical Rainfall Duration

summary.result: From the inundation analysis using the modified Huff method with different rainfall durations, 4 hours showed the largest peak discharge, and 11 hours showed the largest inundation depth.
summary.background: KDS (Korean Design Standard) for agricultural drainage is a planning standard that helps determine the appropriate capacity and type of drainage facilities.
summary.method: From the comparison analysis with the current method (Chicago method with a duration of 48 hours) and the modified Huff method applying critical rainfall duration, the current method showed less peak discharge and lower inundation depth compared to the modified Huff method.

papers.title: 농업용 필댐의 안전진단등급 평가법 개선을 위한 퍼지논리 적용법 개발
papers.title_en: A Development of Fuzzy-Logic Application for Improving Safety Diagnosis Rating Method of Agricultural Fill Dam

summary.result: As the results, it was shown the developed system can give a correct results that was compared with Matlab - fuzzy inference function.
summary.background: In this study, it was developed and verified an application method of fuzzy-logic theory to the rating process of agricultural fill dam safety.
summary.method: More ever it could perform the detailed analysis and improvement on the infrastructure safety rating process using classical diagnosis method.

papers.title: 목재 인삼재배시설에 대한 재생플라스틱의 대체 가능성 평가
papers.title_en: Possibility for the Replacement of Recycled Plastic Products on Timber Ginseng Cultivation Facilities

summary.result: There was no degradation in quality of recycled plastic due to the external environment, and it was found that there would be no problem even if it was used as a structural material for ginseng cultivation facilities.
summary.background: In order to determine the possibility that recycled plastic can replace timber used as a structural material for ginseng cultivation facilities, the specimens collected by elapsed time were compared with timber through bending tests.
summary.method: As a result, the bending strength of recycled plastic specimens with the elapsed time of 360 days was lower than that of timber.
